description: Run code quality audits (synchronous or background), check status, fetch paginated results, and get health checks. Actions: run (sync audit, returns full results), start (background job), status (poll a job), results (paginated violations), health (score + code map).

action.description: Action to perform. One of: run, start, status, results, health.

analyzerConcurrency.description: Max analyzers to run in parallel (default: 1).

analyzers.description: Analyzers to run (default: solid, dry, documentation, react, data-access, data-access-org-filter).

format.description: Output format. "json" (default, structured data) or "sarif" (SARIF 2.1.0 JSON string).

generateCodeMap.description: Generate code map artifacts during audit (default: false).

jobTimeoutMs.description: Max wall time for the audit job (default 30m, cap 4h).

maxFilesPerRun.description: Per worker chunk size for file processing.

minSeverity.description: Minimum severity level to report (high included by default).

path.description: File or directory path to audit (defaults to current directory).

resultId.description: Result ID returned by `audit status` when completed. Also accepts legacy `auditId`.

scope.description: Audit scope: "all" (default), "changed" (files differing from index), "git:<ref>" (diff against a git ref), or a comma-separated list of file paths.

workerCount.description: Number of worker processes (default: min(4, CPU-1)).

name: audit
